title: Grounding
content: Grounding connects an AI response to supporting information, such as retrieved documents or a trusted data source.

meta.why: A response can use current external material, but readers still need to check that the material supports the claim.
meta.example: An assistant consults a current returns policy before answering a question about the return window.
meta.check: Open the cited source, check its date and scope, and compare the answer with the original wording.
meta.limitation: Grounding can improve factual support without making every statement correct, since a retrieved source can itself be wrong.
meta.sources: Google Cloud: generative AI glossary | https://docs.cloud.google.com/docs/ai-ml/generative-ai/glossary | Platform documentation
